messages:
mia: PSA - my PR (#4821) just turned the macOS pre-commit/pyright job red, but only on the macos-lint matrix. Looks like a cache/version mismatch :thinking:

sam: can you paste the failing lines from the job log?

mia: sure, copied the tail: ```
ERROR: pyright cache version mismatch - expected 3 got 2
Run with --clear-cache to rebuild the cache
Traceback (most recent call last): ...
```

jordan: hmm we had a pre-commit bump yesterday that changed pyright pin, could be that. Usually clearing the cache on CI fixes it.

alex: is this blocking merge?

mia: yeah it's blocking the merge gate, pre-commit fails so CI won't green.

sam: quick options: 1) rerun the job with cache cleared 2) force skip-cache env on the job 3) run the local command to repro. If you want me to bisect I can but first try a manual rerun.

mia: repro locally with `pre-commit run --all-files` passes though, which is annoying. The CI runner uses cached pyright artifacts. I'll try a no-cache rerun.

jordan: command we use on CI for that is: ```bash
./scripts/ci/trigger-job --job=macos-lint --no-cache
```
Or on GitHub Actions: `workflow_dispatch` with `CLEAR_CACHE=true`.

ci-bot: Build #12874 for PR 4821 - macos-lint queued: https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/12874 :information_source:

mia: kicked a no-cache rerun just now (cc @sam).

sam: if that passes, we should add a short note to the changelog about the pre-commit/tooling upgrade to avoid future confusion. Also maybe add an automated cache-version bump when pin changes.

ci-bot: Build #12874 for PR 4821 - macos-lint started.

ci-bot: Build #12874 for PR 4821 - macos-lint succeeded ✅

mia: nice, rerun passed and gate cleared. merging now, thanks everyone :thumbsup:

alex: thanks for the quick triage. can you drop a 1-line in the PR about the pre-commit bump so whatever oncall hits this later has context?

mia: will do — added comment and linked the pre-commit PR that bumped pyright.👍

sam: optional follow-up: I can open a tiny CI tweak to expose CLEAR_CACHE env on manual reruns to make this smoother next time.

jordan: sgtm.

mia: done, thanks all.
